rules.rule: Review context is optional per challenge. Missing context must not block processing.
When supplied, preserve challenge, requirement, constraint and priority IDs and use the context as the primary requirements map.
Reconcile supplied review context with the final challenge specification and report material differences.
When absent, derive equivalent context from the final specification using deterministic IDs and source locations.
Do not invent scorecard weights, reviewer comments, platform IDs, runtime versions or unsupported constraints.
Record the active mode as provided_with_spec_reconciliation or specification_derived.
